title: How to download and save your goodies on a phone
notes: Real screens from the website on a phone with a synthetic customer (Sam Taylor), a synthetic order (NLC-10001) and a sample PDF. Save locations follow Apple Support and Google Chrome Help and are worded as 'usually' because people can change them.

scenes.title: How to download and save your goodies
scenes.subtitle: On a phone
say: Hi there!
In this video, I'll show you how to download your goodies on your phone, save them somewhere easy to find, and find them again later.

scenes.title: Sign in to your account
lines: Tap the menu button at the top left.
say: First, let's sign in.
Tap the menu button at the top left.

scenes.title: Sign in to your account
lines: Tap Sign in.
say: Then tap Sign in.

scenes.title: Sign in to your account
lines: Enter your email and password, then tap Sign in.
say: Enter the email and password for your account, then tap Sign in.

scenes.title: Open My downloads
lines: Your account opens.
Tap My downloads.
say: Your account opens.
Tap My downloads.

scenes.title: Find your resource
lines: Each purchase has its own card, with the order number and version.
Ready to save? It says 1 download available.
say: Each purchase has its own card, with the order number and the version.
When it's ready, it says one download available.

scenes.title: Before you download
lines: Each digital purchase includes one download of the latest version.
Starting the download uses it. Just viewing the page does not.
When a new version is released, you get one new download of it.
say: Before you download, here's the important part.
Each digital purchase includes one download of the latest version.
Starting the download uses it. Just looking at this page doesn't.
And when a new version comes out, you'll get one new download of it.

scenes.title: Start your download
lines: When you're ready, tap Download on the card.
say: When you're ready to save it, tap Download on the card.

scenes.title: Start your download
lines: A reminder appears.
Read it, then tap Download now.
say: A reminder pops up.
Read it, then tap Download now.

scenes.title: Save the file
lines: A message says your download has started.
Your browser saves the file on your phone.
say: A message lets you know your download has started.
From here, your browser saves the file on your phone.

scenes.title: Where your file goes
scenes.intro: It depends on your phone. Usually:

devices.label: iPhone or iPad
lines: Safari saves it to the Files app, in Downloads.
A Downloads button also appears next to Safari's address bar.

devices.label: Android
lines: Chrome saves it to your Downloads.
You'll find it in the Files app.

scenes.footer: Tip: keep your inserts together in one folder, like one named Nurse Love.
say: Where it goes depends on your phone.
On an iPhone or iPad, Safari saves it to the Files app, in the Downloads folder.
On Android, Chrome saves it to your Downloads, which you'll find in the Files app.
Tip: keep all your inserts together in one folder, like one named Nurse Love.

scenes.title: Find it again

devices.label: iPhone or iPad
lines: Open Files, tap Browse, then Downloads.
Not there? Look in iCloud Drive.

devices.label: Android
lines: Open the Files app and look in Downloads.
Or in Chrome, tap More, then Downloads.

say: To find it again on an iPhone or iPad, open the Files app, tap Browse, then Downloads. If you don't see it there, check iCloud Drive.
On Android, open the Files app and look in Downloads. Or in Chrome, tap More, then Downloads.

scenes.title: Check your file
lines: My downloads now shows Download used and the date.
The website can't see your phone, so it can't tell if the file saved.
Open the file once to make sure it's there.
say: Back on the website, My downloads now says Download used, with the date.
The website can't see your phone, so it can't tell whether the file saved.
So open the file once, just to make sure it's there.

scenes.title: Need help?
lines: File didn't save or won't open?
Tap Report a download problem. A person at the store reads every report.
say: If the file didn't save, or it won't open, tap Report a download problem.
A real person at the store reads every report.

scenes.title: Need help?
lines: For anything else, tap Support in your account and send a message.
You'll hear back by email.
say: For anything else, tap Support in your account and send a message.
You'll hear back by email.

scenes.title: You're all set
scenes.subtitle: Download once, save it somewhere easy to find, and open it to check.
say: And that's it!
Download once, save it somewhere easy to find, and open it to check.
Thanks for watching.
